titulo: Nobody Is Born Funny — What 50 Years of Research Actually Found
descripcion: Almost everybody believes being funny is something you either have or you don't. Half a century of research says otherwise: humor production can be measured, what predicts it isn't what you think, and it responds to training. This episode covers the standard test, the 2020 meta-analysis, the eight-week Zurich training program, and a one-week exercise you can start tonight — including the part self-help videos leave out.
